title: Contact | Rising Tree
description: Contact Rising Tree Allied Health Services in Chatswood.

sections.title: Start with a conversation.
sections.intro: Whether you already know which service you need or you are still working out the right pathway, tell us what is happening and what you hope to achieve.

form.title: Tell us how we can help.
form.intro: Send an enquiry and our team will contact you. Fields marked * are required.
form.note: For urgent matters, please call the clinic. Do not include medical records or sensitive health details in this form.
form.message: Please contact the clinic by phone or email.

feedback.success: Thank you. Your enquiry has been submitted to our team.
feedback.invalid: Please check your name, email and message (10–5,000 characters), then complete the verification again.
feedback.verification: Please complete the reCAPTCHA verification. If it cannot load, check your connection or contact the clinic by phone or email.
feedback.failed: We could not confirm submission. Your details are still here; complete the verification again and retry, or phone the clinic.
feedback.unavailable: Online enquiries are temporarily unavailable. Please contact the clinic by phone or email.
feedback.noScript: Please enable JavaScript to verify and send this form, or contact the clinic by phone or email.
